key_insight: A proximal policy optimization (PPO) agent can search quantum circuits gate-by-gate to prepare target quantum states with extremely high fidelity while keeping circuits compact.
engineering_relevance: This offers an automated circuit synthesis approach that could reduce manual design effort in quantum compilers and state-preparation workflows as qubit counts grow.
method: Treat quantum state preparation as a sequential decision problem.
Use PPO to append one gate at a time to the circuit.
After each action, recompute fidelity to guide the next gate choice while penalizing unnecessary gates.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on 2–5 qubit benchmarks including Bell, GHZ, W, Dicke, and random states, and it achieved approximation errors as low as 10^-14.
watch_item: Results are demonstrated only on small-scale qubit counts, so scalability and training cost may become challenging for larger circuits.
paper_title: Approximate Quantum State Preparation Through Proximal Policy Optimization
